component.name: MixAI TV
component.summary: Watch your own MixAI Server on the big screen
Media de pe propriul tău MixAI Server, pe ecranul mare

description.p: MixAI TV plays the movies, series, music and Live TV from your own MixAI Server, with an interface made for a big screen, a keyboard, a mouse or a remote.

ul.li: Cinematic home: continue watching, new in your library, recommendations
Movies and series with seasons, episodes and cast; resume on any device
Direct play of your files with subtitles and audio tracks
Live TV from the sources you add
Profiles for the whole family, with PINs and age limits for kids

description.p: MixAI TV needs a MixAI Server (free, self-hosted) on your network or over the internet. Your media stays on your server. To try it, connect to the public demo at https://demo.mixai.ro.
First release of MixAI TV for Linux.
